description: This file defines the 'CloudWatchClient' class which is a client for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch service via the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various CloudWatch operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: CloudWatchClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with Amazon CloudWatch API, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: describeAlarmHistory
methods.description: Retrieves the history for specified alarms.

methods.name: describeAlarms
methods.description: Retrieves alarms based on specified parameters.

methods.name: putMetricData
methods.description: Publishes metric data points to CloudWatch.
